title: Padbear Project Token Dictionary
description: Strict schema for the dictionary an AI agent consults when reconciling spacing values (px read from Padbear overlays) back to named design tokens. Covers CSS custom properties, utility-class frameworks (Tailwind), and structured design tokens with naming conventions and scale boundaries.

$schema.description: Pins the file to this schema so agents can validate before trusting it.

project.description: Machine name of the project this dictionary describes.

cssVariables.description: Map of CSS custom properties (design-system spacing vars) to their computed values. Keys must be valid custom property names.

tokens.description: Structured design tokens. Spacing is required; other scales (radius, color…) may be added but are ignored by Padbear spacing reconciliation.

notes.description: Free-text project conventions the agent must read before mutating code (e.g. 'never inline px; always use var()').

cssLength.description: A CSS length the resolver can compare against measured px values. Only px and rem are allowed — em/%/ch are context-dependent, so the agent could never do exact numeric reconciliation with them.

spacingScale.description: Tailwind spacing keys to resolved lengths, e.g. {"4": "16px"}. A utility is prefix + key: 'p' + '-4' → p-4 → 16px.

spacingPrefixes.description: Spacing-affecting utility prefixes used by this project. The agent joins prefix+key to emit a legal class (p, px, py, pt, m, mt, gap, gap-x, gap-y, …).

importantSuffix.description: Suffix used for important modifiers in this project, e.g. '!' (Tailwind v4) or '!' prefix (v3).

pattern.description: Required token name pattern, e.g. 'space.<step>' where step is a multiple of 100.

boundaries.description: Hard scale limits. A requested value outside [minPx, maxPx] must be rejected or escalated, never silently added.

scale.description: Ordered, exhaustive spacing scale. Must be sorted ascending by value.

name.description: Canonical token identifier used in code, e.g. 'space.400'.

usage.description: One-line intent ('default card padding') so the agent can pick semantically, not just numerically.

ref.description: Optional literal reference to write into source when this token is selected (a CSS var, a Sass variable, a Swift/Dart constant…). Defaults to name.

aliases.description: Legacy or alternate names that resolve to this token.
